title: A finite element exterior-to-interior reconstruction in the fractional conductivity inverse problem
summary: We develop a regularized finite element method for the fractional conductivity equation, recovering the conductivity on an exterior observation region from noisy Dirichlet-to-Neumann measurements and using this reconstruction to determine the interior conductivity. Mesh-localized inputs and mass-lumped Tikhonov regularization discretize the exterior determination principle of Covi--Railo--Zimmermann (2026, Calc. Var. PDE).
